name: Zetsubou no Kotou
source:
It's a jailbreak. Kijima sneaks out of prison during a storm and captains a boat to escape. The boat would be no good before the storm. Caught up in the storm, Kijima loses conciousness. 

When he comes to, he finds he has washed up on some unknown island. He soon realizes to his annoyance that it is a deserted island, bringing absolutely no change from the sexless prison life he had before. However, 2 beautiful women end up coming to the island. It seems that they were tricked by some criminals and deserted on this island.
They were like deer released in front of a starving lion.

A suppressed evil instinct inside of Kijima is awakened.
"Now normally I don't thank nobody, but I gotta hand it to these guys. Thanks for going to all the trouble of bringin' me some easy prey."
In the setting of this crazy world, the story of Kijima begins.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039015.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一场越狱。木岛趁暴风雨之夜潜出监狱，驾船试图逃走，可小船根本无法抵御风暴。木岛被卷入惊涛骇浪，逐渐失去了意识。

当他醒来时，发现自己已被冲上一座陌生岛屿。他很快便懊恼地意识到，这是一座荒无人烟的孤岛，与过去在监狱里无法接触女人的生活没有任何区别。然而，两名美女最终也来到了岛上。看来她们遭到罪犯欺骗，被遗弃在此。
她们就像被放到饿狮面前的鹿。

木岛心中长期压抑的邪恶本能就此觉醒。
“我平常从不感谢别人，但这次倒真得谢谢那些家伙。他们费了这么大劲，特地给我送来了容易下手的猎物。”
在这个疯狂的世界中，属于木岛的故事开始了。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039015.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
